events.verdict: Diabate (CHA) avoids contact with Watkins' (WAS) as he contests his putback attempt.
Carrington (WAS) and Ball (CHA) briefly engage and disengage as they navigate the pick.
Sarr (WAS) is moving alongside Ball's (CHA) path and applies a rested forearm to his side as he defends the driving shot attempt.
Knueppel (CHA) legally defends Sarr's (WAS) pass out of the post.
Diabate (CHA) jumps and maintains verticality as he defends Watkins' (WAS) shot attempt.
Champagnie (WAS) Ball (CHA) mutually engage in marginal contact and separate during the rebound.
Champagnie (WAS) brings his arm toward Ball's (CHA) path and marginal contact occurs during Ball's drive.
Diabate (CHA) establishes himself in Champagnie's (WAS) path prior to the contact.
Champagnie (WAS) cleanly blocks Ball's (CHA) driving shot attempt.
Champagnie (WAS) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
Johnson (WAS) legally contests Ball's (CHA) jump shot attempt.
Knueppel (CHA) contests the jump shot attempt and lands in front of Carrington (WAS) when marginal foot-to-foot contact occurs with Carrington's extended foot.
Watkins (WAS) directly contests Ball's (CHA) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Ball's hand after the release.
Sarr (WAS) commits a take foul on Knueppel (CHA).
Knueppel (CHA) closes out toward Carrington (WAS) and avoids making contact with Carrington during his contest on the jump shot attempt.
Watkins (WAS) commits a take foul on Bridges (CHA). The transition take foul rule does not apply to the last two minutes of either the fourth quarter or overtime.
Carrington (WAS) released the throw-in before 5 seconds elapses.
Miller (CHA) legally contests Johnson's (WAS) jump shot attempt.
